notes.title: Moékuri! in Turn-Based RPG Fest!
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Tactics or Cuteness! Decide the battle with your next turn![/b][/h3]

Moékuri is Culture Select's entry into this year's [b]Turn-Based RPG Fest[/b]! This super adorable SRPG goes all in with solid grid-based strategic gameplay and 151+ cute characters to catch, raise, and fight for victory! Elemental defences, secondary summoning abilities, status effects, terrain modifiers, all that good stuff and more~

[b]Dive into Moékuri today[/b] and grow stronger together with your moé creatures, just as anime intended! 

[i][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27084280/3cf038602c8bbf2dece4d42ea34821168ede5734.jpg[/img]

Whether new or returning, we're glad to have you with us~ Happy Turn-based RPG Fest! [/i]  ːiruseːːnikaːːpenaluːːsusuːːunivaː

notes.title: Happy Valentine's Day! Happy Lunar New Year 2024!
notes.notes:
It's the Year of the Dragon! Soar through the skies amidst a dazzling display of fireworks and let the festive spirit warm your heart like a gentle lantern glow. Wishing everyone joy, prosperity, and good fortune all year long! May the cute and courageous dragons in Moékuri bless your team with many victories to come~ 

新年快乐！新年快樂！Happy Lunar New Year!

notes.title: Spooky Team of Moé Contest!
notes.notes:
Trick or Treat! Halloween is just around the corner, and we want to take this opportunity to reward some of our most devious players with delicious moé goodies--like a limited Moékuri fanbook!

Put on your thinking caps and create the best Halloween team: Enter the Spooky Team of Moé Contest and show off your creatvity and skill! Submission Deadline: November 30th 2018, (23:59 PST). Check out the official discussion thread for details on how to enter and win: 

[url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/529160/discussions/0/1733216893892341602/]Spooky Team of Moé Contest! Click to learn more![/url]

Thank you for supporting Moékuri and looking forward to your entries!

notes.title: Moekuri Chinese Version Released!
notes.notes:
Thank you everyone for waiting! v1.0 of Chinese localized version of Moekuri has been released! We really appreciate everyone's patience and the hard work of our translator, Yi Tian, who translated the whole game and this very message!

We really hope everyone enjoys the new release and all the adorableness of each girl!

notes.title: 莫库里中文版本进入Alpha测试阶段啦！
notes.notes:
大家好！关于上一次的公告，我们不小心把五月发过的内容又重新发了一遍，实在是太抱歉了！

今天这次公告是想要给大家一个中文版本的进度报告噢！

在下方我们发布了一个短视频，视频中大家可以看到一些中文版游戏的第一章节中的内容：

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F6WR27OHo1c
我们整个团队里只有一名中国成员，所以工作量确实是蛮大的，但是我们确实有意识到这边发布公告和回复不是很勤，在此对大家深表歉意。正如我们的公司名字所寓意的，我们希望能够打破语言和文化的屏障，将游戏以尽可能多的语言呈献给不同地区的玩家，这是我们第一次进行中文的本地化，进度确实不如我们预期中的那么快，所以想要在这里和大家道歉，真的很不好意思。看到大家都很期待莫库里的中文版本，并且愿意支持小公司的独立游戏，我们真的很开心，谢谢大家！

我们计划在未来几周内发布中文版本，我们知道大家已经等了很久了，但是这边确实是想要确保游戏有尽可能少的bug，等我们测试工作做完之后会立刻发布更新，希望大家届时也可以支持我们~！

同时希望大家喜欢本作里可爱的美少女们噢~苏苏即是正义！

- Culture Select团队

notes.title: 中文翻译100%完成啦！
notes.notes:
感谢大家耐心的等待，我们已经完成了所有文本的翻译，并开始着手进行下一步工作了！预计我们在未来几周之内就可以完成全部后续工作，并将中文版的游戏呈献给您。这是我们第一款面相中国玩家的游戏，在此我们想要感谢中国玩家社区对我们的支持！
 
对于大家在绿光上给我们的支持，我们表示十分感谢，希望大家喜欢这款又可爱又有战术性的游戏噢~！

notes.title: Spanish and Chinese Translations on the way!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We just wanted to let everyone know that Spanish and Chinese translations are in the works! 

The Spanish translation will be coming out within the next few weeks, and the Chinese translation will be after that! A lot of quality assurance goes into testing all the game features, stopping overflows, and unicode display - so please be patient! It's in the works.
